req.title: Reject empty title on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field of POST /tasks/ is missing.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject task creation requests with an empty title by returning an HTTP 422 status code. This behavior ensures data integrity by enforcing mandatory fields. The test suite includes a positive test to verify normal operation, a negative test to confirm rejection of invalid input, and a boundary test to check edge cases.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid title and description.
expected: The response contains the created task with the correct title and description.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "New Task", "description": "A valid task description."}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "New Task"
assert response.json()["description"] == "A valid task description."

tests.name: test_create_task_with_empty_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an empty title.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the title is required.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "", "description": "A task without a title."}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]
assert response.json()["detail"][0]["msg"] == "ensure this value has at least 1 characters"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_boundary_title_length
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of maximum allowed length.
expected: The response contains the created task with the correct title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "X" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": max_length_title, "description": "A task with max length title."}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == max_length_title
assert response.json()["description"] == "A task with max length title."
